summary: SmartStop Self Storage REIT filed a Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that its Board declared a monthly dividend for October 2026, consistent with a targeted annualized payout of $1.60 per share. The declared amount is $0.13589041 per share, payable November 13, 2026 to holders of record as of the close of business on October 30, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change is involved; the filing is a routine dividend declaration and does not present risk-arbitrage considerations.
